verdict.rationale: x402 is a payment protocol with a hosted facilitator service, and a hosted developer service could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows external AI agents paying for services through x402 (agentic accounts, Bazaar MCP discovery, AgentCore integration). None of it documents a built-in AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
